An AI classifier that assigns severity level (critical, high, medium, low) to incoming IT support tickets based on ticket description, system logs, and historical incident patterns.

An AI-powered search and matching assistant that identifies duplicate or related tickets by comparing the new ticket description against historical incident records and currently open tickets, surfacing potential matches for the on-call engineer to review.

A classifier that identifies recurring hazard patterns across all logged inspections (e.g., 'electrical hazards at Site A', 'fall risk in multi-story work') and flags sites or asset types with disproportionately high hazard frequency for proactive intervention.
